chars.SISTER: SISTER: a Moroccan young woman about 22 with long wavy black hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie and grey sweatpants
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a Moroccan young woman about 22 with short curly dark-brown hair, wearing a red-and-white striped long-sleeve pyjama top and dark blue jeans
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20 with a short fade haircut and light stubble, wearing an olive-green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt and black jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Afternoon, a girl's bedroom in a Moroccan family apartment with a wardrobe and a dresser with drawers. Seen from the half-open doorway: the friend sits on the bed next to the sister, laughing with her, but her eyes slide sneakily toward the sister's dresser drawer with a sly curious look. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan apartment staircase with patterned zellige tiles. The sister walks down the stairs casually, carrying an empty glass, looking down at her phone. Head-to-waist framing, face visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A young man's bedroom in a Moroccan apartment, a TV with a game console controller. The narrator sits on his bed holding a game controller, frozen, leaning his head toward the wall with one ear turned, eyebrows raised, hearing strange rustling noises from the next room. Head-to-waist framing, face visible, comic curious mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Seen through the narrow gap of a half-open bedroom door, from the hallway: inside the girl's bedroom the friend stands alone at the open dresser drawer, holding a folded pink piece of the sister's clothing up close to her face with her eyes closed, a guilty dreamy expression. Head-to-waist framing, face visible, awkward comic mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, a Moroccan school courtyard with arches and a few trees. In the middle ground the friend stands very close to another girl in a white school coat in a quiet corner, the two whispering secretively face to face; in the foreground the narrator, seen from behind at three-quarter angle, watches them from far with a suspicious frown. Faces visible.
